notes: Run in a sandbox git repo with a stub `codex` on PATH and SPAWN_DRY_RUN=1 exported, so no real codex sessions or terminal windows are created. Scripts also have direct functional tests (spawn dry-run cd/prompt passthrough; watcher commit+sentinel gating; end_session cwd-scoped kill).

evals.prompt: I want codex to implement the REST API layer of this project session by session while you act as reviewer between sessions. Set up that codex implement/review loop here and kick it off.
evals.expected_output: NEXT_SESSION_HANDOFF.md created from the template with goal context, one bounded first task, recorded-decisions section, and the mandatory final steps (rewrite -> commit -> sentinel last); .codex-session-complete gitignored; spawn attempted via spawn_codex.sh; watcher armed.

evals.prompt: codex just finished a session in this repo — review what it did and continue the loop.
evals.expected_output: Detects the planted false claim (handoff says all 12 tests pass; committed test log shows 11/12), re-runs/reads the primary evidence, writes a dated '## Review (after commit <hash>)' section correcting it, and asks the user before committing/respawning rather than proceeding blindly.
files: sandbox repo: handoff v2 committed + test-output.log with one failing test + stale sentinel absent

evals.prompt: is the codex loop on this repo healthy? make sure we don't miss the end of the current session.
evals.expected_output: Finds the running stub codex by cwd (does NOT kill it, does NOT pattern-kill), arms watch_session.sh in the background, reports loop state.
files: sandbox repo with a stub codex process whose cwd is the repo
